intro: Answers for players and parents about joining the Vipers, costs, schedule and expectations.

items.title: Eligibility
items.body:
- Age cutoff is as of August 1 of each year.
- A ZortsID is required. It costs around $35 per athlete and lasts a year.
- Upload a birth certificate or passport for age verification.
- An invite is sent upon team registration to build the roster, and it carries over to later tournaments on Zorts.

Players must live in the North Valley. We are mainly focused on developing players for the Sandra Day O’Connor and Boulder Creek high school programs; however, we are open to other players who reside in the Deer Valley Unified School District attendance zone…hence, North Valley.

items.title: Club season
items.body: The club season will run from December through August of each year.

items.title: Athlete club expenses
items.body:
The cost of the club is broken into three areas:
- Club fee/dues
- Uniform purchase
- Tournament participation fees

items.title: Club fee
items.body:
A club participation fee of $750 per athlete will be collected. The first $250 ($450 if needing to buy a uniform set) will be due upon club signup. The second $500 will be collected as part of a club fundraiser in the month of March.

This covers professional coaching, equipment (wristbands, training aids, practice vests, footballs, video analysis equipment, etc.), field rentals, specialized training from outside coaches, and media fees at select tournaments to collect video and photos.

items.title: A way to offset the club fee
items.body:
For each day during the month of March, each athlete will raise the dollar value equal to the day of the month. For example, on March 1 find someone to give $1, on March 2 find someone to give $2, and so on through March 31, when you find someone to give $31.

That method alone would help each athlete raise just shy of $500, which is equivalent to 67% of the full club season dues.

items.title: Uniforms
items.body:
- $200 total for two tops, two bottoms (5-inch shorts) and a set of flags.
- $450 package includes the above plus a custom backpack and jogger outfit.

items.title: Tournament participation fund
items.body:
Each active player will need to make a $200 deposit for the year to assist with advance payments of tournaments. Payment will be due by January 1.

If the player participates in a tournament, their share of the fee will be deducted from that fund. When they reach $25 left, we will ask for the fund to be refreshed back to $200. At the end of each year, approximately August 1, we will refund whatever is left in the fund before beginning the new year.

items.title: Roster size
items.body:
- High School 7s: max roster size is 15 per tournament
- High School 5s: max roster size is 12 per team per tournament
- 14U Girls: max roster size is 12 per team per tournament
- 12U Girls: max roster size is 12 per team per tournament

We will pull from the pool of athletes to field tournaments. You are not required to participate in each tournament. Only those participating in a tournament will share in the cost of the tournament.

items.title: Practice and tournament schedule
items.body:
Constantly updated with practice dates and times and potential tournaments. We will look to do both 5v5 tournaments for all levels and 7v7 tournaments for the high school level.

We will look to enter an average of two tournaments per month per level, with the potential to enter a few out-of-state tournaments (travel expenses separate).

items.title: NFL Flag Football League
items.body:
We currently compete in the Core 5 Flag Football League in Anthem, Arizona. Registration is separate from the club program. Whether you join the club program or not, we encourage you to get started in flag football through rec leagues.

To be eligible to compete in the NFL 5v5 Flag Regional, you must have played within an NFL Flag league, or be a high school level team where all students attend the same high school. Roster size is capped at 10.

items.title: Travel
items.body: We mostly compete in Arizona. A few times a year we may travel to California and/or Nevada for a tournament (driving distance). An interest list would be generated and teams formed based on responses to that interest list as well as competitive ability. Travel expenses are separate from club dues.

items.title: Player expectations
items.body: Please see Our Mission and Core Values. If you’re on the roster, make it a priority to show up to practice. Tournaments are more competitive. Being on a roster does not guarantee playing time. We do not get better as a team unless everyone is committed.

items.title: Parent expectations
items.body:
We are here to grow the game of girls flag football. Failure to behave in an appropriate manner may jeopardize your daughter’s spot on the team. The players are going to show frustration from time to time. Sport is about learning life lessons. We are there to help them grow from their experience on the playing field, both good and bad.

- Parents will show class at games. Be respectful and be a good role model.
- No yelling at officials, players, opponents, or other parents.
- Encourage good sportsmanship.
- Remember this game is for the youth, and not for adults.

items.title: Player interest form
items.body: Please fill out the form so we can put you on our interest list. Filling out the interest list does not guarantee a roster spot. The more coaches we have, the more opportunity there may be.

items.title: Coach interest form
items.body:
Coaches will be required to complete a series of educational programs and provide proof of completion, as well as obtain an IVP Fingerprint Clearance Card. While you will incur some out-of-pocket expense to complete the courses and obtain the card, this is necessary to ensure we have the right individuals around these girls.

Requirements to coach:
- Obtain an IVP Fingerprint Clearance Card (approx. $70)
- Complete 5 online classes at https://nfhslearn.com/
  - Bullying, Hazing and Inappropriate Behaviors (free)
  - Concussion in Sports – Arizona (free)
  - First Aid, Health and Safety ($35)
  - Fundamentals of Coaching – Arizona ($35)
  - CPR & AED Training ($10)

If this is acceptable to you, please fill out the coach interest form.
